# Storage and delivery contract

The event allowlist includes session/editor telemetry plus lesson, task,
question, selection, code-run, compiler/test, hint, idle/stuck, and teacher
intervention activity. Payload is serialized to JSON and stored as a ClickHouse
`String`. Intervention-relevant events require a stable `event_id` and bounded
aggregate fields; other payloads remain arbitrary JSON objects.

`BufferedEventSink.Publish` acknowledges after placing an event in a bounded process-local channel. Rows flush when the configured batch size is reached, the interval fires, or shutdown drains the channel. An HTTP 200/202 or WebSocket acknowledgement therefore does not mean durable persistence. When `InsertBatch` fails, the error is logged and the in-memory batch is cleared without retry, dead-letter storage, or client notification. Process failure can also lose acknowledged events.

Migration `0001_init.up.sql` owns the `stat_events` MergeTree table, partitioned by event date and ordered by task/user/session/time. The legacy `course_version_id` column remains, but the current repository always inserts the zero UUID. The migration runner executes every sorted `*.up.sql` file and has no migration-history table; the Taskfile rollback command only prints a message even though a destructive down SQL file exists.

Summaries group stored events by task and session for the supplied user. Start/end are minimum/maximum event time; typing count includes `key_press` and `typing_stats`; reading time is the interval before the first such event; solving time is total minus reading; average is total session duration divided by session count. These are heuristics, not authoritative study progress or proof of a completed task.

Learning-session summary policy `learning-analytics-active-time-v1` caps every
gap between adjacent events at 60 seconds before summing active time. It also
counts observed completed lessons/tasks, questions, selections, code runs,
failures, passed tests, hints, interventions, and stuck signals. These are
analytics facts, not Student progress or mastery claims.

The active-time aggregate is a non-null ClickHouse `Int64`, scanned into a
signed Go value before exposing integer seconds. Each gap remains clamped to
the range 0–60 seconds; event-count aggregates retain their unsigned scan types.

When configured with NATS, the service publishes only cheap bounded
`learning.activity.interesting` observations to `LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS`.
Publication is best effort after in-memory telemetry acceptance; Teacher owns
the later deterministic speak-or-stay-silent decision.
